title: {{Clients}}
emptyText: Add your first person or group. By default we use a code instead of a name.
deleteConfirmText: All records will be deleted (assessment, plan, sessions, measurements). You can undo this for a short while.

fields.codeHint: Pseudonymisation: e.g. “AK-17” instead of a full name.
fields.fullNameWarning: Not recommended. Only enter identifying details when truly necessary and in line with your organisation's rules.
fields.sexHint: Needed for AUDIT-C and DUDIT cut-offs.
fields.strengthsHint: Where we start – interests, skills, values, achievements.
fields.keyDatesHint: E.g. end of probation, leaving the facility, court hearing – they appear under “Worth attention”.

privacyNotice.title: Before you add the first person
privacyNotice.text1: Keep records of real people in line with your organisation's rules, professional confidentiality and data protection law (GDPR). Use codes instead of names.
privacyNotice.text2: During your studies and placements use training mode (DEMO) – it contains fictional cases for practice.

diagnosis.emptyText: A structured assessment covers 8 areas of functioning, risk and protective factors and resources.
diagnosis.areasHint: Rate functioning from 1 to 5 and add short observations.
diagnosis.note: Educational / social rehabilitation assessment – not a medical diagnosis.

ipr.emptyText: Individual plan: SMART goals, actions, responsible people, deadlines and progress reviews.

smartHint.measurable: How will we know it worked?
smartHint.achievable: Is it realistic with current resources?
smartHint.relevant: Why does it matter to this person?

ipr.evaluationHint: What changed, what helped, what do we adjust?

relapse.emptyText: High-risk situations, triggers, warning signs, coping strategies and a plan for a lapse.
relapse.intro: A plan made together with the person – in their own words. You can print it as a card.
relapse.warningHint: Thoughts, feelings and behaviours that signal trouble ahead.
relapse.lapsePlanHint: What will I do after a one-off return to the behaviour? No judgement – it is information to learn from.

timeline.intro: Sessions, measurements and important events in one place.
timeline.title: Title
timeline.lapseNote: Describe a lapse without judgement – as information about a high-risk situation and a chance to learn.

genogram.emptyText: Map people, institutions and groups and the relationships between them – useful in family work.
genogram.canvas: Genogram editor – drag elements; arrow keys move the selected element
genogram.help: Drag to move. Tap an element to edit or connect it. Keyboard: Tab + arrow keys.
genogram.selectHint: Tap a person or relationship in the drawing to edit it.
genogram.label: Label
genogram.connectHint: Tap the second person or institution to create a relationship.
genogram.legendSymbols: □ male · ○ female · ◇ person · rectangle – institution · ellipse – group · shaded half – substance problem · ✕ – deceased

measurements.emptyText: Results of screening and interactive tools will appear here as charts.

readaptation.emptyText: Checklist for someone leaving a facility or prison: housing, documents, work, health, relationships, support.

familyPlan.emptyText: Family goals, strengths, forms of support and agreements.
familyPlan.intro: A support plan for the family – loved ones need help too.
familyPlan.safetyHint: Is anyone in the family experiencing violence? What are the safety arrangements?
familyPlan.violence: In Poland, domestic violence is handled through the “Blue Card” (Niebieska Karta) procedure.
familyPlan.violenceLink: See the procedure and help paths
